releases.notes:
## v1.1.0 — Siege Overhaul & Create Goggles Integration

### New Features
- **Create Engineer's Goggles HUD:** Wearing Create's Engineer's Goggles (helmet slot or Curios) now displays a live structural integrity overlay (HP, color-coded bar, material tier, SecurityCraft owner, and repair hint) when looking at fortified blocks.
- **Manual Block Repair:** Owners can now repair damaged blocks with `Shift + Right-Click` using configurable items (`create:wrench`, `minecraft:iron_ingot` by default), with owner checks, cooldowns, optional item consumption, and Action Bar feedback.
- **Per-Munition Multipliers:** Separate damage multipliers for HE Shells, AP Shells, AP Shots, Solid Shots, Mortar Stones, Drop Mortars, Autocannons, and Grapeshot/Shrapnel/Flak bursts.
- **Admin Commands (`/cbcbreach`):** Added `inspect [pos]`, `clear <radius>`, `clearall`, `status`, and `reload`.
- **Overrides & Blacklist:** Added `customBlockHp` (`modid:block=hp`) and `blacklistedBlocks`, plus `dropBlocksOnBreak` (`false` by default so raided fortified blocks don't drop themselves as items).
- **Impact & Breach Feedback:** Added configurable hit/breach sound effects and block particles.
- **Crack Sync on Chunk Load:** Crack overlays and HP data now automatically re-sync when players reconnect or enter chunks with damaged bases.

### Bug Fixes & Performance
- Fixed direct cannon projectile hits (Big Cannons, Autocannons, and Grapeshot/Shrapnel/Flak bursts) for Create Big Cannons 5.11.7.
- Fixed explosions hitting the same block dozens of times per detonation by deduplicating per explosion and using the strongest ray; rebalanced explosion/kinetic damage accordingly.
- Added a post-hit combat grace period (`decayGracePeriodTicks`, default 60s) and slowed automatic damage decay (5% every 30–60s) so walls no longer out-heal cannon reload times.
- Fixed `Group.COPPER` mapping typo so `reinforcedCopperHp` / `reinforcedCopperResistance` now work properly, and expanded material matching (`reinforced_door`, `blackstone`, `amethyst`, `dripstone`, etc.).
- Fixed intangible/non-reinforced SecurityCraft blocks (lasers, scanner fields, fake fluids, mines) being treated as fortified blocks.
- Prevented `DamageDecayHandler` from force-loading unloaded chunks, crashing when `min > max`, or freezing after switching singleplayer worlds.
- Cleared orphaned damage immediately when blocks or double-block doors (`ReinforcedDoorBlock`) are broken.
- Switched config to `SERVER` type (auto-synced in multiplayer), replaced string HP values with validated `DoubleValue` entries, isolated client-only registration for dedicated servers, and made per-block caches thread-safe.
- Updated all 8 translations (`en_us`, `es_es`, `de_de`, `fr_fr`, `ja_jp`, `pt_br`, `ru_ru`, `zh_cn`).

> **Upgrading from v1.0:** Delete the old `config/create_big_cannons_security_breach-common.toml` file; v1.1.0 generates a new `config/create_big_cannons_security_breach-server.toml` config with updated schema and balanced defaults.
